children: The EU is scrutinizing Broadcom’s VMware licensing changes amid concerns they may be hurting customers.

EU officials have sought information from European cloud providers on the importance of VMware products and whether those services can easily be replaced, as well as details of any unfair restrictions stemming from new certification arrangements,

The heightened scrutiny comes ahead of a March 31 deadline that could cut smaller European providers off from selling VMware subscriptions. Broadcom introduced the licensing changes after acquiring VMware in 2023, prompting concerns over Broadcom allegedly scrapping existing contracts and adding costly new licensing conditions.
The merger itself was approved by the EU after Broadcom offered “a set of comprehensive access and interoperability commitments” to rival Marvell Technology

title: Broadcom’s VMware licensing overhaul faces deeper EU scrutiny: report
